Chapter 611: Chapter 36 Lin Yuan And Hunyi (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 611: Chapter 36 Lin Yuan and Hunyi (Please Subscribe)_2

No way.

Compared to the reproductive abilities of human civilization,

those Ancient Gods from the depths of the universe mostly come from special life forms. Their talents are terrifyingly strong, but their ability to reproduce is pitifully weak; some unique special life forms don’t even have the ability to reproduce, wandering the vast cosmos without a single kindred soul.

Thus, the Ancient God Ancestor of the Maduo Traveler valued this descendant extremely and did not hesitate to pay the price to create this life-saving trump card.

…..

In the depths of the cosmic starry skies.

...

The true body of the Maduo Traveler immediately informed the Ancestor of what had happened in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“The Galaxy Master has taken the initiative to reveal himself?” The Ancient God Ancestor’s massive body sat there, beginning to affect the surrounding space and time. He stroked his chin and said, “When the Galaxy Master is on the brink of life and death, activate the ‘Time Black Hole’ I gave you.”

“Understand?”

“You must not hesitate at all.”

The Ancient God Ancestor cautioned, for if it was too late and the Galaxy Master were killed by Hunyi, then such a long time would have been wasted.

If it was too early and the Galaxy Master had not yet despaired, the favor they did would not seem as significant.

“Understood, Ancestor.”

“I am ready at all times.”

The Maduo Traveler nodded, even though he did not know why the Ancestor placed such importance on the Galaxy Master, going as far as to offend the Tianyu Clan to curry favor with him.

But over the long years, the Ancestor had moved effortlessly among several peak clans, not as a Supreme Being but with a vision that allowed him to manage.

Even two Supreme Beings had received ‘funding’ from the Ancestor before they had risen to power.

…

“Hahaha, Galaxy Master, it seems you know your end,” Hunyi rapidly sealed off all the spatial layers around them, looking at Lin Yuan who stood calmly and relaxed, not immediately moving to kill.

Within the spatial layers he sealed off, even if a Ninth Rank from human civilization on the same level as him were to rush over now, it would be pointless.

With the spatial layers thoroughly locked down, Hunyi could easily shift Lin Yuan into his own inner world with just a thought.

Thus, at this moment, Hunyi was savoring the sight of Lin Yuan, having pursued him for nearly three years, he was certainly feeling a touch irate.

He wanted to deeply embarrass the Galaxy Master.

Hunyi also knew that the Galaxy Master could blow up this avatar in an instant; it was impossible for him to bring the Galaxy Master back to his clan alive.

“Galaxy Master, you still haven’t blown yourself up, it seems you’re quite unsatisfied?” Hunyi spoke.

He was also aware of the Galaxy Master’s talents and qualifications; stepping into the Tenth Rank in the future would pose no difficulty, perhaps even one day catching up to himself.

But what of it? At least for now, he, Hunyi, could crush the Galaxy Master.

“Hunyi.” Lin Yuan also looked at Hunyi, shaking his head slightly and said, “Right now, you’re too weak.”

“Too weak?” Hunyi was stunned, then burst into laughter, “Looking to vent your frustration before death?”

Even a Tenth Rank powerhouse wouldn’t call him weak; being able to open over thirty million spatial layers at the Ninth Rank was not something just anyone could achieve.

“I don’t even care to speak with you,” Lin Yuan sighed.

Originally, he had wanted to mock Hunyi after ending the chase, but now, the gap between them was too vast, not even a thought to scorn remained.

“You’re not interested in talking to me?” Hunyi scoffed, about to respond.

The next moment.

Hunyi’s expression drastically changed.

Because, in the blink of an eye, the spatial layers he occupied were forcefully banished by a nearly brutal force, a trace of fear streaking across Hunyi’s face.

In less than a breath, he lost all control over the surrounding spatial layers, and all the layers he could sense were occupied by a brand-new force, the number of layers captured by this power far surpassing thirty million.

“You?”

Hunyi broke into a cold sweat, looking at Lin Yuan with disbelief, the fresh force being that of the Galaxy Master that he considered to be securely in his grasp.

“Die.” Lin Yuan’s expression remained tranquil as boundless layers of space crushed down with just a thought.

“How could you?” Fear surged in Hunyi’s heart, not hesitating to blow up his avatar.

If he did not destroy his avatar now, Hunyi felt that he might actually be captured alive by the Galaxy Master.

Then, if this avatar fell into the hands of the Galaxy Master and was brought back to the Human Civilization Territory, and with the help of this avatar, if cursed killing techniques or memory poisons and such were used, he, Hunyi, could very well face complete annihilation.

…

In the Tianyu Clan territory.

Hunyi’s true body opened his eyes, showing an expression of utter disbelief.

“What happened?”

“How could that Galaxy Master possess such strength?”

“`

“I can feel it, the spatial layers he occupies far exceed thirty million, no, at least a hundred million. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be possible for just the spatial layers to instill such a sense of powerlessness in me, right?”

Hunyi couldn’t believe it, a hundred million spatial layers? Throughout the history of the Tianyu Clan, none of the Ninth Rank beings had ever developed such a number of spatial layers, not even those unique special beings could open up so many layers.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Xilan, who was originally in despair, watched as Hunyi was forced by Lin Yuan to expose his avatar, and suddenly felt bewildered.

What’s going on?

What happened?

Xilan’s mind was a mess.

“Galaxy Master…” Xilan looked towards Lin Yuan standing beside her, subconsciously.

Although she didn’t know why Hunyi self-destructed, it must be related to the Galaxy Master.

“The Galaxy Master has taken over all the surrounding spatial layers?” Xilan also felt the many layers of space being dominated by Lin Yuan.

Although Xilan couldn’t determine exactly how many layers were occupied, the pressure she felt at this moment was far greater than when Hunyi was pursuing them.

“Alright.”

“Hunyi is dealt with.”

Lin Yuan stretched out his right hand, and Hunyi’s space bracelet fell into his hand.

“Dealt with?”

Xilan felt as though she was dreaming. She had contemplated countless possibilities, such as dying at the hands of Hunyi along with Lin Yuan, or Lin Yuan’s “elder” suddenly arriving.

Or, perhaps a special Ninth Rank alien race friendly to human civilization would appear and intervene on their behalf against Hunyi.

Or even the sudden emergence of a terrifying native beast from the secret realm to entangle Hunyi.

She had run through countless possibilities and speculated about many scenarios. Almost every one of them had crossed her mind.

But she had never imagined Lin Yuan forcing Hunyi to self-destruct with a mere gesture.

It was too incredible.

…

In the distance.

The many Ninth Rank alien races who were watching the drama unfold had their eyes bulging with disbelief.

“Hunyi self-destructed?”

“What’s going on? Why would he self-destruct for no reason?”

“Nonsense, it’s because of the Galaxy Master. All the surrounding spatial layers have been taken over by the Galaxy Master. The Galaxy Master’s strength is far above Hunyi, forcing Hunyi to self-destruct.”

…

All the Ninth Rank aliens watching the battle were in an uproar, unable to predict that the situation would take such an unexpected turn. Hunyi, with victory within his grasp, was forced to self-destruct, while the Galaxy Master, apparently at an absolute disadvantage, suddenly demonstrated nearly inconceivable strength.

…

Deep in the cosmic starry skies.

The real body of the Maduo Traveler was somewhat dazed. He had witnessed the unfolding scenario in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and precisely because of this, he was so bewildered.

“What’s the situation now?”

“Did you use that ‘Time Black Hole’ I gave you?”

The massive Ancient God Ancestor immediately asked. In his estimation, with the Galaxy Master making an appearance, the worst Hunyi would do was to shame the Galaxy Master for a bit.

He wouldn’t let the Galaxy Master live much longer.

At this moment, it was critical for the Maduo Traveler who was hiding nearby to use the ‘Time Black Hole’ at the critical moment to trap Hunyi and save the Galaxy Master.

This was the process envisaged by the Ancient God Ancestor. Through this incident, not only would the Maduo Traveler completely reconcile with the Galaxy Master, but he could also win the favor and goodwill of the Galaxy Master.

“No…” The Maduo Traveler was stunned and, after a moment of silence, he responded.

“No?” The Ancient God Ancestor frowned, slightly annoyed: “Why didn’t you activate the ‘Time Black Hole’? Do you think this life-saving trump card is too precious?”

“Foolish!”

“Such a life-saving trump card, given time, I can completely create a second or third one. But the Galaxy Master’s goodwill, after the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, will you still have this opportunity?”

The Ancient God Ancestor looked at the Maduo Traveler with a mix of frustration.

“Ancestor….” The Maduo Traveler shrank a little and said, “I did plan to use it.”

“Then why didn’t you use it?” The tone of the Ancient God Ancestor rose as he was about to continue his scolding.

“Because Hunyi is dead, killed by the Galaxy Master.” The Maduo Traveler steadied himself and said somewhat aggrievedly, “I didn’t even have the chance to use it.”

“The Galaxy Master killed Hunyi…”

The Ancient God Ancestor fell silent, staring at the Maduo Traveler with surprise and suspicion.
